title: The workspace obligation row was marked covered, but the cited contract defines one branch per task while a card is one run of many tasks, so no per-change branch is proven
resolution: The row is partly covered: the base branch per prepare is cited for the met part, and item 16 closes the per-change branch through a versioned change of the item 6 contract

title: The obligation trace requirement allowed only covered and open, while the table also used partly covered and later-gate statuses
resolution: The requirement names four statuses, covered, partly covered, open, and not a G3 item, each with what it carries, and a scenario covers the partly met case; the table and its legend use the same names

title: The integration branch row was marked open, though the merged item 9a contract already holds the project's integration branch in its repository binding
resolution: The row is covered by the 9a contract (`docs/contracts/control-plane-wire-contracts.md:61`) and the OpenAPI schema `RepositoryBindingInput`, and binds item 11; verification.md lists the remaining open rows

title: The obligation table cited product ports lines at a3a0ac4c after the merge of 10fc3bbe moved them, so lines 208, 230, and 271 pointed to the wrong text
resolution: The table is pinned to 10fc3bbe, every citation of the table and the design was reread there, the moved lines are 211, 233, and 274, and the legend, design risk, and verification.md say so

title: The scenario Council before OpenCode expected that the council is not constituted and human approvals apply, which the requirement did not state
resolution: The requirement adds that until OpenCode is admitted the council SHALL NOT be constituted and human approvals SHALL apply; it is 491 characters

title: The G6 pilot scenario used the unobservable state about to complete and a rationale clause that did not follow
resolution: WHEN the G6 pilot completes, THEN G9 has already closed; the rationale stays in ADR 0016

title: The design did not carry the pass 1 fixes: D2 had no partly covered status and two rows for ADR 0013's second bullet, and D6 gave 284 characters
resolution: D2 names the four statuses and the three rows, and D6 gives the measured lengths 491, 171, and 452

title: ADR 0016 decision 1 said gaps are marked open with the item that closes them, while partly covered rows name a gate
resolution: Decision 1 says each obligation has its status, covered, partly covered, open, or not a G3 item, as the G3 plan's legend defines them

title: The workspace row called the not-only-the-project-branch part met, though the contract takes the base branch from the project's repository binding
resolution: The row says the port type takes the base as a parameter, the contract takes it from the project's binding, and the rule for an intent's integration branch changes with item 16's versioned change or in G9

title: The architecture's first integrations row said OpenCode may come first, which reads as before Claude Code, and broke the sentence
resolution: The row says OpenCode possibly before Antigravity CLI, in G10, and the GitHub.com clause follows a semicolon

title: verification.md omitted product-ports.md:70 from the read citations, listed a make verify after the first commit under the pre-commit checks, and promised totals that the record does not show
resolution: The citation list includes :70, the f17bcee8 run is under the checks after the fixes, and the route section states that the docs-only profile reports no test totals
